data.body_html:
New Year's Eve 2030 in Marbella means one thing: watching the Puerto Banús fireworks from the deck of your own private boat. No crowds, no traffic jams – just you, your guests, and a sky full of colour over the Mediterranean. Our fleet of 18 boats departs directly from Puerto Banús, putting you metres from the action. Prices start at €749 for a 2-hour charter, including skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Here’s everything you need to plan your Marbella boat rental New Year's Eve 2030 fireworks experience.

Why Watch the Fireworks from a Boat?

The Puerto Banús fireworks are launched from the breakwater at the mouth of the marina. From land, you’re shoulder-to-shoulder with thousands of revellers on the Golden Mile or the port promenade. From a boat, you have an unobstructed 360° view of the show reflecting off the water. The sound echoes across the bay, and you can anchor exactly where the best perspective is. Plus, you control the music, the drinks, and the company. It’s the most exclusive seat in Marbella.

Our Fleet for NYE 2030

We have boats for every group size and budget. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden costs.

Best Boats for a Big Group

If you’re celebrating with 10–12 friends, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is our top NYE recommendation. It has a spacious flybridge, a saloon with panoramic windows, and a free jet ski included on 4-hour charters. The Ferretti 94 (29m) offers even more luxury with a jacuzzi and full crew. For a balance of size and speed, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) cruises at 25 knots and has a large aft deck perfect for dancing.

What’s Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish VAT (21%)

You can bring your own food, decorations, or a cake. Just let us know via WhatsApp so the skipper can prepare. No corkage fees.

How to Book Your NYE 2030 Charter

Contact us on WhatsApp with your preferred boat, number of guests, and charter duration. We’ll check availability and send a secure payment link. Early booking is essential – NYE slots are usually fully booked by late November. For the Mangusta 80, we recommend booking at least 6 weeks in advance due to high demand. Check our fleet page for more details on each boat.

NYE Itinerary Ideas

Most charters depart from Puerto Banús between 22:00 and 23:00. Cruise along the coast past the Golden Mile, anchor near the breakwater for the midnight fireworks, then head back to port. If you book a 4-hour charter, you can also sail to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a pre-fireworks swim (sea temperature is 16°C in December – invigorating!). The skipper will suggest the best route based on wind and crowd conditions.
